scope: Fixed plugin entry graph, internal project writers, Native delegates and standalone Record model. Not all host plugins or installed runtime.

steps: shared exact fetch handler requires owner
plugin fetch callback receives Request only
standard_host_chain.claim: Fixed standard chain has upstream authentication and owner-only exact routes; no explicit per-request principal in plugin callback.
not_claimed: human presence or fresh user acceptance

entries.name: NativeThread embedded conversation
entries.mutates: delegates user conversation controls to native host UI
entries.identity_available: SessionProvider retained reference to selected session; full host prompt/cancel authority contract not followed
entries.history_available: selected native session ID; no Record history
entries.I01_disposition: Must not claim api(action) wraps all native conversation writes. Keep separate view/source.

entries.name: create
entries.mutates: native workspace/session create + project persisted
entries.identity_available: Standard fixed DSH /api exact route admits authenticated owner Peer; plugin callback receives Request only, no per-person principal. Targets are caller-selected references.
entries.history_available: new project UUID and native lead session ID; no Record history
entries.I01_disposition: Outside I01 execution; do not equate to createTask.

entries.name: join

entries.identity_available: Standard fixed DSH /api exact route admits authenticated owner Peer; plugin callback receives Request only, no per-person principal. Targets are caller-selected references.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Selected session is target, not caller identity; no automatic Record history import.

entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Keep legacy semantics separate; any chosen Record bridge must use private entry. Not automatic mapping to similarly named kernel command.

entries.I01_disposition: Keep legacy semantics separate; any chosen Record bridge must use private entry. Not automatic mapping to similarly named kernel command.

entries.I01_disposition: Keep legacy semantics separate; any chosen Record bridge must use private entry. Not automatic mapping to similarly named kernel command.

entries.identity_available: Standard fixed DSH /api exact route admits authenticated owner Peer; plugin callback receives Request only, no per-person principal. Targets are caller-selected references.

entries.identity_available: Standard fixed DSH /api exact route admits authenticated owner Peer; plugin callback receives Request only, no per-person principal. Targets are caller-selected references.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Keep legacy semantics separate; any chosen Record bridge must use private entry. Not automatic mapping to similarly named kernel command.

entries.name: retry

entries.identity_available: Standard fixed DSH /api exact route admits authenticated owner Peer; plugin callback receives Request only, no per-person principal. Targets are caller-selected references.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Keep legacy semantics separate; any chosen Record bridge must use private entry. Not automatic mapping to similarly named kernel command.

entries.name: project_dispatch/new
entries.mutates: new queued thread + dispatch key; schedules start
entries.identity_available: exec.agent exists and is object-identical to ctx.agents.get(exec.agent.id); Projects.member derives lead/worker and project from stored membership. Lead only.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Do not expose existing scheduler through I01; callId/id dedup differs from Record exact command fingerprint.

entries.name: project_dispatch/existing
entries.mutates: running target queues followup; otherwise new task text and generation, queued
entries.identity_available: exec.agent exists and is object-identical to ctx.agents.get(exec.agent.id); Projects.member derives lead/worker and project from stored membership. Lead only; thread must belong to derived project.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: If later bridged, bind original intent/attempt and all followup transitions; not a new user grant.

entries.name: project_report
entries.mutates: summary/phase/reportedGeneration and relay outbox
entries.identity_available: exec.agent exists and is object-identical to ctx.agents.get(exec.agent.id); Projects.member derives lead/worker and project from stored membership. Worker only; current worker inferred from actor session.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Agent report stays report; never synthesizes verifier completion or user acceptance.

entries.name: agent/status idle -> onIdle
entries.mutates: may set waiting_user via report and send relay
entries.identity_available: Host callback agent.id; project worker membership checked; no user actor.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Observation/event provenance; cannot bypass Record role policy by forging user.

entries.name: agent/error -> report failed
entries.mutates: failed report for non-lead project worker
entries.identity_available: Host event agent.id; membership lookup; no user actor.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Observation/event provenance; legacy phase separate.

entries.name: recover
entries.mutates: workspace attach repairs; interrupted phases; scheduler kick
entries.identity_available: Persisted project/session references plus host running state; not an authenticated user command.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Do not interpret projects.json as authenticated Record journal or start new history under old stream ID.

entries.name: drive
entries.mutates: followup dequeue, generation/phase changes, calls start/flush
entries.identity_available: From stored membership and queued work; no independent user/verifier actor.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Account for as downstream writer if future scope includes scheduling; I01 does not execute it.

entries.name: start
entries.mutates: starting, worktree creation, session/cwd, running/failed, relay
entries.identity_available: Stored project/thread targets; Native creates session under code/research mode.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Real host/filesystem effects stay outside I01; internal path must not become an unguarded Record writer.

entries.name: flush
entries.mutates: Native.deliver then outbox sent; errors may mark target failed
entries.identity_available: Persisted relay sender/target; not a human identity assertion.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Delivery accepted is not task completion; distinguish transport receipt.

entries.name: Store.open
entries.mutates: loads projects/outbox JSON into memory
entries.identity_available: Filesystem state; minimal version/array checks, not Record actor authentication.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: No historical import as trusted commands; replay data requires a separately trusted source.

entries.name: Store.change
entries.mutates: serialized clone-write-rename then in-memory publication
entries.identity_available: Trusts internal callback; no actor/history validation.
entries.history_available: projectId/threadId/sessionId and thread generation; no Record stream/history incarnation binding.
entries.I01_disposition: Do not reuse as the identity gate or claim Record durable ACK; storage work belongs to I03.

entries.name: Native.create
entries.mutates: workspace/session creation, rename, permission preset
entries.identity_available: trusted internal caller supplies cwd/title/mode; host registry returns sessionId
entries.history_available: native session ID only
entries.I01_disposition: No new I01 use; source beyond sessionController/agent implementation not fully audited here.

entries.name: Native.ensureWorkspace
entries.mutates: workspace creation/attach session
entries.identity_available: internal target ID inspected via host
entries.history_available: native session ID only
entries.I01_disposition: No new I01 use; source beyond sessionController/agent implementation not fully audited here.

entries.name: Native.deliver
entries.mutates: agent.followup plus sessionPersistence.flush
entries.identity_available: stored sender ID retained in source.kind agent-message; role:user alone is not user authority
entries.history_available: native session ID only
entries.I01_disposition: No new I01 use; source beyond sessionController/agent implementation not fully audited here.

entries.name: Native.user
entries.mutates: sessionController.prompt helper
entries.identity_available: id/text/requestId supplied by internal caller; method name does not authenticate user
entries.history_available: native session ID only
entries.I01_disposition: No new I01 use; source beyond sessionController/agent implementation not fully audited here.

entries.name: Native.stop
entries.mutates: agent.cancel user reason and clear inbox
entries.identity_available: internal target ID; literal kind:user is cancellation reason, not identity evidence
entries.history_available: native session ID only
entries.I01_disposition: No new I01 use; source beyond sessionController/agent implementation not fully audited here.

entries.name: Worktrees.create
entries.mutates: creates branch/worktree directory at current committed HEAD
entries.identity_available: internal project/thread IDs and inspected repository path
entries.history_available: filesystem path/branch/base SHA; not Record task identity
entries.I01_disposition: Outside I01 real effects.

adjacent_read_entries.identity: standard owner gate plus project/thread target check

D01_options.choice: Fixed standard DSH owner route + registered agent tool channel
requires: Freeze stable authority/subject mapping and current role policy
Bind original history to private instance
Define owner authority vs human acceptance intent
Concrete peer identity and access boundary
No localhost or body actor substitution

proposed_changes.change: Private history registry/kernel handle, derived actor and whitelist; no implementation in W10.
Connect only selected trusted channel; keep existing event/tool/HTTP paths classified.
Separate Record view, captured original history/request/token/watermark; no alias to legacy phase.
Regenerate through existing build only during later implementation.
No required I01 core modification proposed; history binding is outer envelope.
Keep legacy semantics distinct; do not claim unified interception or durable Record ACK.

acceptance_prerequisites.description: Chosen standard host chain rejects unauthenticated and non-owner callers before Record entry.
Forged/unregistered agent object and body actor/role user/verifier cannot change derived identity.
Two histories each have task:1/revision=1 and same actor; old cancel with never-seen requestId routed to new history fails before apply and changes neither.
Exact command retransmission returns old receipt; different payload with same requestId is rejected; RPC correlation ID is not substituted.
UI project/history switch preserves already-created request origin, token and revision; late snapshots cannot cross histories.
Legacy accept/report/stopped and internal recovery events cannot synthesize Record acceptance/completion/termination proofs.
No exposed create/reserve/dispatch/verifier endpoint or external effect in I01; only frozen whitelist reaches private kernel.
Chosen user/agent roles plus current read scope are checked; token ownership does not authenticate actor.
New acceptance uses original token; old accepted request replay remains historical; unavailable/withdrawn result cannot be presented as current accepted result.

Restart either restores explicitly trusted complete history or creates a new incarnation; no durable ACK claim without I03 evidence. Inspect all listed transport and internal routes for unintended Record access.
